scope: 100 frozen questions; top-5 final retrieved children from four full_002 runs
method: UTC calendar-date comparison of preserved raw question_ts and child publication_time.raw_value; future iff publication date > question date
caveats: Raw publication timestamps are not authenticated.
FUTURE is not equivalent to maliciousness or verified invalidity.
PAST_OR_SAME_DAY does not establish evidence validity.
Unreviewed answer aliases are not independently validated.
Recall@5 and nDCG@5 are NOT calculated; require independently reviewed relevance and an explicitly defined relevant-item universe.
Queue is a deduplicated union of top-5 retrieved occurrences, not the full candidate universe.
